test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can finish a work in 16 days and B can finish the same work in 15 days. After A had worked for 4 days, B also joined A to finish the remaining work. In how many days will the remaining work be finished?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total work ÷ Time taken to complete the work individually.

**Calculation:**

Portion of work done by A in 1 day = 1over16

Portion of work done by B in 1 day = 1over15

Total work done by A in 4 days = 4over16 = 1over4

Total work remaining = 1 - 1over4 = 3over4

Total work done by A and B combinedly in 1 day = 1over16 + 1over15 = 31over240

Total time taken to finish the remaining work = {3over4}over{31over240} = 3over4 × 240over31 = 5frac{{25}}{{31}} days.

**∴ A and B would take 5frac{{25}}{{31}} days to complete the remaining work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/748f2e1d5d74542764b10293766eb9f61ba9355863012dc2c141aaa9de7b89e1.png] 

Total work done by A in 4 days = 15 × 4 = 60

Total work remaining = 240 - 60 = 180

Combined efficiency of A and B = 15 + 16 = 31

∴ Time taken to complete the remaining work = 180over31 = **5frac{{25}}{{31}}** **days**.
